description:
**Job Title: Product Manager – Trainee** 




  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for highly motivated and analytical MBA graduates to join our team as
 **Product Manager – Trainee** 
 . This is an exciting opportunity for aspiring product professionals to work closely with product leaders, engineering teams, and business stakeholders in building next\-generation AI\-powered accelerator platforms, products, and enterprise solutions.
 



 The selected candidate will gain hands\-on experience in product strategy, customer research, market analysis, roadmap planning, and product lifecycle management while contributing to innovative AI\-driven products.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Assist Product Leaders in defining product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Conduct customer research to understand user needs, business challenges, and pain points.
* Gather and analyze customer feedback to identify opportunities for product enhancement.
* Define and document use cases, user stories, and product requirements.
* Create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog in collaboration with engineering teams.
* Work closely with highly skilled engineering teams developing AI\-based platforms, products, and solutions.
* Support market research activities, including industry trends, customer insights, and competitive analysis.
* Collaborate with marketing teams on product positioning, messaging, and go\-to\-market initiatives.
* Monitor product performance and recommend improvements based on data\-driven insights.
* Prepare presentations, reports, and product documentation for internal and external stakeholders.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  




* MBA (2025 Pass\-out or later) from a reputed Business School with a First\-Class academic record.
* 0\-1 year of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, Consulting, Technology Management, or related areas.
* Specialization in one or more of the following:
* IT Management/Information Systems Management/Technology Management/Digital Transformation/Analytics
* Strong understanding of product management concepts and methodologies.
* Excellent analytical thinking, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate business problems into product requirements and use cases.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness to work from Chennai.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Certifications in Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI.
* Understanding of:
* Generative AI (GenAI)
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Agentic AI
* Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Exposure to product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of enterprise software products and digital platforms.
* Strong business acumen with an innovation\-driven mindset.



  





**Relevant Experience Preferred** 




  




* Academic or internship projects related to Product Management, Business Analysis, AI, Analytics, or Digital Transformation.
* Exposure to customer research, market analysis, or competitor analysis.
* Experience preparing business cases, product presentations, or strategic recommendations.
* Participation in product management competitions, hackathons, innovation challenges, or startup initiatives.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams comprising business, technology, and marketing functions.



**Location** 




 📍 Chennai (Work from Office)

title: Catalog Manager
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Catalogue Executive is responsible for managing the organization's product catalogue across all categories, ensuring every product is accurately represented in catalogues, quotation tools, and internal systems. The role focuses on catalogue accuracy, product data management, new product launches, SKU management, pricing updates, and supporting seamless collaboration between Category, Procurement, Design, Sales, Operations, and Technology teams. The objective is to maintain ascalable, standardized, and error\-free catalogue that enables excellent customer experience and
 



 efficient business operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Catalogue Management:** 



* Manage and maintain the master product catalogue, ensuring all product information is accurate, standardized, and up to date across all cities and platforms.
* Create, modify, and archive product records, ensuring discontinued products are removed and new products are added as per approved timelines.
* Maintain a consistent category hierarchy, product groupings, and catalogue version control.



  





**2\. Product Data Management:** 



* Ensure complete and accurate product information, including specifications, dimensions, finishes, materials, warranties, images, and descriptions.
* Validate product data received from vendors and internal stakeholders before publishing it in the catalogue
* Maintain data consistency across catalogues, quotation tools, and other business systems.



  





**3\. Pricing Management:** 



* Update product pricing, discounts, and commercial information based on approved price revisions from the Category and Procurement teams.
* Verify pricing accuracy before releasing updates to ensure error\-free quotations and customer proposals.
* Maintain historical pricing records and support periodic price revisions.



  





**4\. Product Launch Management:** 



* Coordinate the end\-to end catalogue readiness for new product launches, ensuring all product information, images, pricing, and documentation are available.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure products are launched within committed timelines.
* Support the preparation of product launch materials, catalogues, and internal communication.



  





**5\. SKU Management:** 



* Create and maintain unique SKU codes for all products while ensuring there are no duplicate or incorrect entries.
* Update SKU mappings whenever products are modified, discontinued, or introduced.
* Maintain the master SKU database to support inventory, quotation, and reporting systems.



  





**6\. Quote Builder \& System Management:** 



* Coordinate with the Tech team to upload new products, pricing updates, and configuration changes into the Quote Builder and related systems.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate data accuracy before system releases.
* Report and follow up on system issues to ensure minimal disruption to business operations.



  





**7\. Vendor Coordination:** 



* Liaise with vendors to collect product catalogues, images, specifications, pricing, warranty information, and other required documentation.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely submission of updated product information.
* Maintain organized records of all vendor documents and communications.



  





**8\. Documentation Management:** 



* Maintain and regularly update product rate cards, technical specifications, installation guidelines, comparison sheets, and other catalogue\-related documents.
* Ensure all documentation follows company standards and version control practices.
* Support the preparation of internal reference documents for Sales, Design, and Operations teams.



  





**9\. Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 



* Collaborate closely with Category, Procurement, Partners to ensure seamless catalogue updates.
* Communicate product changes, launches, and pricing revisions to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Support cross\-functional initiatives aimed at improving catalogue quality and business efficiency.



  





**10\. Catalogue Quality Control:** 



* Conduct regular audits to verify the accuracy of product information, pricing, images, specifications, and category mappings.
* Identify and resolve catalogue discrepancies before they impact customer quotations or project execution.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance catalogue accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.



  





**Educational Qualification:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Data Management or Information Management, or a related field.
* Experience in the Interior Industry is an added advantage.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum 2 years of experience in Catalogue Management, Product Management, Procurement Coordination, or Data Management.



  





**SKILLS REQUIRED:** 



* Advanced Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* Data Validation
* Basic ERP/CRM understanding
* Version Control Behavioural Skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams and external vendors
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Process\-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement
* Ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to work
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems and processes

title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

title: Product Manager – AI Security
description:

 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Start Date:** 
 November 2026 or February 2027
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\+ years
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 We're hiring
 **two technical Product Managers** 
 to own core areas of this new AI security platform.
   

  

 You'll join one of two workstreams:
   

  

* Cloud Discovery: Build a continuously updated inventory of the AI agents, models, and AI\-enabled applications running across customers' cloud environments, including the data and permissions they can access. This role requires strong knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud security.
* AI Security Platform: Own a core area of the platform across gateway, agentic security, forensics, or shared platform capabilities, working closely with engineering, security research, design, and enterprise customers.


 Both roles require a PM who has
 **shipped B2B security or infrastructure products** 
 , is technically comfortable working with engineering teams, and uses AI tools as part of their daily product workflow.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own the roadmap, requirements, and prioritization for your product area from discovery through launch.
* Lead customer discovery with CISOs, security architects, and cloud/AI platform teams, translating customer needs into clear problem statements and PRDs.
* Partner with engineering and security research on scope, technical trade\-offs, and delivery, and participate in technical design reviews.
* Define success metrics and ensure the product measures adoption, coverage, and detection effectiveness.
* Work with product marketing, sales engineering, and support on positioning, enablement, and launches.
* Track the evolving AI security landscape, including agent frameworks, LLM providers, regulation, and competitors, and translate relevant developments into product strategy.
* Use AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, and day\-to\-day product work.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 5\+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, including 2\+ years working on security, cloud infrastructure, or developer\-facing products.
* Proven track record of shipping products used by enterprise security or infrastructure teams, with measurable outcomes.
* Strong technical fluency: comfortable reading API specifications, discussing distributed\-systems trade\-offs, and understanding how LLM applications and AI agents are deployed.
* Strong written communication and the ability to produce clear PRDs, decision documents, and executive updates.
* Practical, daily use of AI tools and LLM/agentic workflows in your own product work.
* Fluent English and comfortable collaborating with distributed teams across time zones.
* Strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast\-moving environment.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Product experience in cybersecurity, including DLP, CASB, SIEM, EDR, CSPM/CNAPP, or AI security.
* Strong practical knowledge of a major cloud provider, including services, IAM, and inventory/audit APIs.
* Engineering background or hands\-on scripting experience, particularly Python.
* Experience working with AI compliance and regulatory frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted or agentic workflows into product teams.


 AI\-First Team
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team works.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in your own product work, including the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed your workflow.
   

  

 We're looking for people who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for research, productivity, problem\-solving, and decision\-making** 
 , not simply as a writing or autocomplete tool.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Shape a new product line at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
* Work directly with engineering, security research, and enterprise customers on emerging security challenges.
* Own a significant product area with high visibility and influence.
* Help define how enterprises discover, understand, and secure AI systems.
* Join a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of daily work.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)

 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

title: SME-Product info & MDM
description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid night shift role focuses on managing product information and master data to support efficient order management and trading operations for an MNC. The SME will optimize data flows between systems ensure accuracy of product and order records and collaborate with cross functional teams to improve retail order processes. The role contributes directly to customer satisfaction and stable trading performance by maintaining reliable data foundations and supporting continuous improvement a
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end ownership of product information and master data flows for order management and trading systems ensuring accurate synchronized data across core platforms to support consistent execution and reliable reporting
* Manage creation update and maintenance of product master records including attributes hierarchies pricing and availability so that downstream order and trading processes operate with clean structured data
* Coordinate closely with order management operations teams to analyze data issues impacting order capture fulfillment and settlement and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence and reduce manual interventions
* Collaborate with trading and commercial stakeholders to define data rules for item setup bundle management and promotional constructs ensuring that business strategies are reflected reliably in system configurations
* Monitor nightly data loads and interface jobs across hybrid environments addressing exceptions in near real time to secure uninterrupted processing and timely visibility for global teams
* Design and maintain data quality checks and validation routines that detect anomalies in product and order data enabling early remediation and continuous improvement of master data standards
* Document functional data models for order management and trading processes translating complex concepts into clear reference materials that support onboarding and knowledge sharing across teams
* Partner with technology teams to refine mapping logic between product information management master data management and order platforms focusing on performance scalability and resilience of integrations
* Support incident analysis for data related defects in night shift operations providing structured root cause insights and proposing pragmatic solutions that enhance customer experience and operational stability
* Contribute to process optimization initiatives across retail order flows by proposing enhancements to data structures configuration rules and workflows that reduce cycle times and improve order accuracy
* Engage with stakeholders in hybrid working sessions to gather requirements for new product and order data capabilities and convert them into well defined specifications that guide implementation and testing
* Perform impact assessments for product and master data changes across reporting billing and trading processes ensuring that dependencies are understood and that transitions are executed safely without disruption
* Promote adoption of master data governance practices through clear communication of standards guidance on best practices and active participation in forums that strengthen data discipline across the organization


**Qualifications**
* Possess four to seven years of hands on experience as a subject matter expert in product information and master data within complex order management and trading environments demonstrating strong ownership of data outcomes
* Bring solid practical expertise working with core order management platforms and trading systems including configuration troubleshooting and data analysis to keep high volume operations running smoothly
* Apply demonstrated exposure to retail order management scenarios such as omnichannel ordering and inventory visibility translating domain understanding into better data design and process alignment
* Show capability in documenting requirements user stories and data dictionaries in a clear and structured manner making it easier for cross functional teams to deliver enhancements and maintain solutions
* Demonstrate strong analytical skills using data profiling and issue analysis techniques to identify root causes of product and order data problems and to recommend sustainable corrective actions
* Operate effectively in a hybrid work model and dedicated night shift environment maintaining proactive communication and coordination with onshore and offshore partners without needing travel
* Exhibit familiarity with master data management principles including governance stewardship and lifecycle management applying them to improve reliability and reusability of product and order data assets

title: Consultant, Customer Experience & Business Process Improvement (CX&BPI)
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

title: Principal Technical Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 Help build the enterprise AI runtime and agentic platform that will power AI solutions across Optum.
   

  

 AI Factory Runtime and Agentic Platform Services provides a secure, scalable platform that enables engineering teams to deploy and operate AI workloads and agents across private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments.
   

  

 As Principal Technical Product Manager \- AI Runtime, Agentic Platform \& Compute, you will own the product strategy for this critical layer of AI Factory. You will transform GPU compute, Kubernetes, model serving, inference, agent runtimes, agent orchestration, multi\-agent execution, lifecycle management, and observability into enterprise services that development teams can easily consume.
   

  

 You will define the product vision, roadmap, service model, and investment priorities while partnering with Engineering, Compute, Cloud, Security, Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Architecture leaders to build a high\-performance enterprise AI platform.
   

  

 This role owns the AI runtime, compute, and operational agent platform experience. It does not own underlying physical infrastructure, enterprise model approval and Responsible AI policy processes, or the business\-specific agents, AI applications, and solutions built by consuming teams.
   

  

 AI can only scale across the enterprise when engineering teams have secure, reliable, and easy\-to\-consume runtime and agent platform capabilities beneath their solutions.
   

  

 You will turn advanced GPU, Kubernetes, AI runtime, and agent execution technologies into standardized enterprise services that help teams move AI workloads and agents into production faster, while integrating with enterprise\-approved model access, security, and governance services.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to shape a foundational AI platform serving one of the world's largest healthcare enterprises and influence how engineering teams securely deploy and operate AI workloads and agents at enterprise scale.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for AI Factory Runtime and Agentic Platform Services across private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments
* Define clear product boundaries, ownership, and integration points across AI Factory, Compute, Cloud, Security, Governance, Architecture, enterprise AI enablement services, and consuming AI solution teams
* Productize GPU compute, Kubernetes/OpenShift, model serving, LLM inference, agent runtimes, agent orchestration, multi\-agent execution, agent lifecycle management, and platform APIs into standardized services engineering teams can easily consume
* Define the roadmap and service model for operational agent platform capabilities, including agent deployment, execution, orchestration, scaling, lifecycle management, observability, tool connectivity, and governance integration
* Create a leading developer experience, including self\-service onboarding, service tiers, APIs, SLOs/SLAs, documentation, consumption models, and platform automation
* Develop a deep understanding of AI workload, agent workload, and customer requirements and translate them into platform capabilities, architecture priorities, and measurable business outcomes
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to evolve AI runtime and agent platform capabilities across private cloud, Azure, AWS, GCP, and hybrid environments while abstracting infrastructure complexity from consumers
* Partner with Security, Governance, Risk, and Compliance teams to incorporate security, privacy, Responsible AI, observability, and governance requirements into platform services without duplicating enterprise policy, model approval, or governance ownership
* Partner with Compute and Cloud Engineering to understand workload demand and improve GPU utilization, capacity efficiency, platform performance, reliability, and cost effectiveness
* Drive enterprise adoption and measure success through outcomes such as time\-to\-first\-workload, time\-to\-first\-agent, platform utilization, reliability, onboarding speed, adoption, and customer satisfaction
* Influence senior technology leaders and drive decisions across competing customer, engineering, architecture, security, operational, and investment priorities
* Technology Environment
+ This role will influence a modern enterprise AI runtime and agentic platform incorporating technologies and practices such as:
+ Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift
+ NVIDIA GPU platforms
+ GPU\-enabled container workloads
+ AI model serving and inference
+ Agent runtimes
+ Agent orchestration and multi\-agent execution
+ Agent lifecycle management
+ Tool and API connectivity
+ Public and private cloud
+ APIs and automation
+ GitOps
+ Observability and telemetry
+ Platform engineering
+ Experience with every technology is not expected. We are looking for someone with strong platform fundamentals who can rapidly understand emerging AI and agentic technologies and translate them into enterprise products

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience across technical product management, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, architecture, or related technology leadership roles, including significant product ownership or product leadership experience
* Experience owning, designing, or shaping an enterprise platform, developer platform, cloud service, Kubernetes platform, distributed compute platform, agent platform, or comparable technology product
* Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, service models, SLOs/SLAs, adoption metrics, consumption models, and investment priorities
* Solid understanding of Kubernetes/container platforms, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, platform engineering, or GPU/AI compute architectures
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex infrastructure, runtime, and agent platform capabilities into simple, consumable platform products and developer experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex platform strategies to executive audiences and influence senior engineering, architecture, security, product, and business leaders without direct authority
* Proven ability to build consensus and make trade\-offs across competing customer, engineering, architecture, security, operational, and business priorities


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or a related discipline
* Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute, model serving, LLM inference, agent runtimes, agentic platforms, agent orchestration frameworks, multi\-agent systems, or AI runtime platforms
* Experience with Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, NVIDIA GPU technologies, or other large\-scale container and accelerated\-compute environments
* Experience with enterprise AI or cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, or similar technologies
* Experience with agent deployment, execution, orchestration, lifecycle management, observability, or tool connectivity patterns
* Experience building platforms spanning private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments
* Experience with developer self\-service, platform engineering, observability, capacity management, FinOps, or AI governance integration
* Experience delivering technology platforms within large\-scale or highly regulated enterprises


**The Candidate We're Looking For**
* The solid candidate will think of infrastructure, runtime, and agent platform capabilities as products rather than simply technologies.
* You should be comfortable moving between AI workloads, agent workloads, GPU compute, Kubernetes, APIs, developer experience, platform economics, and executive strategy without needing to be the deepest engineer in every technology.
* You enjoy taking complex infrastructure and agent platform capabilities and making them simple for developers to consume. You can make decisions while technology and customer requirements are changing rapidly, and influence a large organization through technical credibility, product thinking, and a clear vision for where the platform needs to go.


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Manager - Regional Product development
description:
**Job Details** 




 To introduce the right regional products by generating an in\-depth understanding of cultural, ritualistic and community specific requirements for jewelry and by undertaking extensive indexing of relevant competition. On this basis to work closely with the Cluster management and the regional teams for determining the appropriate sales plan and the supporting assortment plans. This role will also be responsible for identifying regionally relevant products or categories that can be imbued with Tanishq’s signature and promoted as such. As a part of the WiMI programme, this role will also work closely with the regional DEC and the Cluster management teams on the development of regionally relevant, marketed collections aligned to regional marketing calendar
 



  





**Merchandising: Planning for Regional Products** 




 1\. Mapping the current universe of regional products
 



 2\. Range\-planning for regional products: Identifying the gaps in the current universe, based on customer, community understanding as well as competitive indexing. Accordingly, planning for product introduction for ensuring that these product gaps are filled
 



 3\. Collaborating with the regional vendors to ensure the development of products to fill the product gap happens on a regular \& timely basis.
 



 4\. Wherever required, work closely with the Responsible Sourcing teams for the timely onboarding on relevant and capable vendor partners
 



 5\. Review of product performance and decision making on product continuation 6\. Engaging closely with the Retail stores for driving decisions on range expansion/discontinuation
 



  





**Developing a Robust vendor ecosystem for regional products** 




 1\. Evaluating the current vendor ecosystem for regional products both in terms of expertise \& cost 2\. Periodic visits to the vendors to understand their capability as well to get inputs from vendors on regional products.
 



 3\. Conduct existing vendor performance evaluations based on product performance and evaluate new vendors based on the skill set planning.
 



 4\. On boarding the right new vendors in terms of expertise \& cost as per the gap observed in the current regional vendor eco\-system
 



  





**Periodic Competition Indexing** 




 1\. Monthly visits to regional competition to benchmark the regional products offered, weight bands, making charge ...etc.
 



 2\. Synthesis of actionable insights and incorporation into the Range plan
 



  





**Product Management: Product Portfolio Management** 




 1\. Manage the entire product lifecycle from inception to product retiral for regional products.
 



 2\. Achieve Category Top Line Targets as per planned Cat\-PB sales shares of regional products.
 



 3\. Provide inputs on the model stock recommendations for assortment planning.
 



 4\. Ensure the effective cascade of the newly launched regional products with all the internal teams including Retail, VM, Marketing etc.
 



 5\. Identify poor performing products and propose measures for ensuring their liquidation.
 



 6\. Identify the best possible offers based on the seasonality in the region \& the profitability of the product.

 5\. Coordinate with the NPD \& NPIM team to ensure that the first set of proto are received as per the design approved – if not ensuring that the feedback is given for correction.
 



 6\. Support the NPD to conduct regional NPIM for the collection.
 



 7\. Conduct periodic canvassing with L3s for indent enhancement, seasonal up stocking etc. to improve new product penetration.
 



 8\. Collaborate with marketing for ad\-variant planning

 Education \- Graduate Relevant Experience 10 \-15 years with experience in Sourcing or Product development or Design or Merchandising functions with National or Regional jewelry brands.
 



 Prior work in the jewelry sector and a thorough understanding of regional nuances is a must Behavioural Skills

title: Innovation Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




 We invite you to join the ZEISS Innovation Hub Chennai to shape together with us the future of advanced frugal innovation. We are turning today’s research into tomorrow’s applications – together with academic partners, students and entrepreneurs. Located at the IIT Madras Research Park, you will work in direct neighborhood to a world\-leading universities and with many startups co\-located in this dynamic environment. You will:
 



 • Drive new topics under the umbrella of advanced frugal innovation, by identifying and evaluating opportunities in the innovation sweet spot of desirability, feasibility, and viability
 



 • Find and work with partners in these topics in close cooperation with ZEISS stakeholders
 



 • Conduct innovation and market studies, identify customer needs, and develop solution concepts as part of an interdisciplinary team
 



 • Initiate and steer projects (incl. external partners) in the development of novel solutions (e.g., proof\-of\-concept demonstrators) and ensure the transfer of relevant knowhow to ZEISS
 



 • Support the successful transfer of concepts, technologies, and solutions to ZEISS business units
 



 • Screen and evaluate startups with strategic relevance for the Inno Hub's topics
 



 • Develop new business and venturing proposals and ideally lead your topic through incubation with our internal venture unit
 



  





 ZEISS employees work in a place where expert knowledge and team spirit reign supreme. All of this is supported by a special ownership structure and the long\-term goal of the Carl Zeiss Foundation: to bring science and society into the future together.
 



  





**Job Requirements** 



1. Ideally looking for 8\-12 years of relevant experience, can extend to 17 years.
2. A university degree in Mechanical engineering, physics, material sciences, or other relevant STEM fields, ideally with a PhD/M. Tech
3. Good knowledge in Solid works/CAM/CAD.
4. Profound knowledge in mechanics (elasticity and plasticity), materials science, finite element modeling, manufacturing (additive and subtractive), and other relevant fields
5. Ideally experience in innovation management or (internal) venturing, relevant methodologies such as design thinking, business models, lean startup, and software’s such as Miro, Power BI, Sharp cloud etc. for visualizing idea funnels
6. An intrapreneurial mindset, a holistic view of innovation and a desire to take topics beyond technology to market success
7. Experience in project management
8. A “together we go far” (collaboration) and “just do it” (action\-bias) mindset
9. Passion for innovation and enthusiasm for new technologies as well as fun working in agile, interdisciplinary, and cross\-border teams
10. Ability to persevere in the process of idea creation and rejection, with a positive mindset

 Bachelor Degree or equivalent

 Chennai

 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. title: Manager II Program Management, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1\) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMES and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2\) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3\) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4\) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**As a Manager II, Program Management You Will**
* Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
* Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
* Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
* Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team
* Drive quantitative, data\-oriented decision making across the portfolio and champion the adoption of technology solutions and process improvements
* Communicate program progress, risks, and results to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals
* Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
* Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in\-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained across programs, with corrective actions that keep commitments on track and minimize losses
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices that promote long\-term, scalable solutions in dynamic environments
* Drive continuous improvement and decision\-making strategies across the team and the broader function


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 5\+ years of team management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in data mining, data management, reporting, and SQL queries

title: Sr Manager - Technology & Platform Development
description:
**About The Company**
 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

**Job Requirements (JR)**
 Senior Manager (B4\-1\) \- Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the strategy, product development, transformation, onboarding, orchestration, and engineering evolution of the Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) portfolio, encompassing SD\-WAN, Secure Service Edge (SSE) and Secure Internet Access.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Lead\-to\-Order (L2O), Order\-to\-Cash/Order\-to\-Billing (O2C/O2B), and Trouble\-to\-Resolve (T2R) customer journeys, service orchestration platforms, AI\-enabled automation, API\-driven ecosystems, and cloud\-native security architectures. The position will drive seamless customer onboarding, service lifecycle management, policy\-based provisioning, and Zero\-Touch MACD (Move, Add, Change, Delete) operations across the SASE portfolio while enabling scalable digital service delivery and customer experience transformation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**SASE Product Strategy \& Portfolio Management**
* Drive product strategy, portfolio evolution, onboarding, and lifecycle management for SASE services including SD\-WAN, SSE, and Secure Internet Access.
* Define and execute product roadmaps aligned with enterprise security, cloud transformation, and digital connectivity strategies.
* Lead portfolio modernization initiatives to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, automation, and service adoption.
* Partner with business, product management, security architecture, and commercial teams to develop next\-generation managed SASE offerings.


**Product Development \& Engineering Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end telecom and security software product development, release governance, roadmap execution, and portfolio transformation.
* Lead engineering teams responsible for service onboarding, orchestration, workflow automation, and customer lifecycle management.
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native, API\-first, and microservices\-based architectures across SASE platforms.
* Ensure scalable and secure service delivery through standardized engineering and operational frameworks.


**Digital Customer Journey Transformation**
* Lead transformation initiatives across L2O, O2C/O2B, and T2R value streams for SASE products.
* Drive self\-service capabilities for provisioning, configuration management, policy deployment, service upgrades, and MACD operations.
* Improve customer onboarding, service activation, assurance, incident management, and billing experiences through automation and orchestration.
* Enhance digital channels and customer portals to support secure service consumption and lifecycle management.


**Service Orchestration \& Automation**
* Lead implementation and integration of Service Orchestration platforms, Cisco NSO, MSO, SD\-WAN controllers, and cloud security management platforms.
* Drive onboarding of SASE services onto orchestration platforms for automated fulfillment and service activation.
* Enable policy\-driven provisioning, Zero\-Touch deployment, automated configuration management, and lifecycle automation.
* Govern orchestration architectures spanning CRM, Order Management, Inventory, Security Platforms, Assurance, and Billing ecosystems.


**API \& Ecosystem Integration**
* Define API\-led integration strategies across OSS/BSS platforms, security vendors, hyperscalers, and network domains.
* Drive adoption of TM Forum Open APIs, API management frameworks, and digital ecosystem integrations.
* Lead integration initiatives involving Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, orchestration platforms, and security technology stacks.
* Ensure interoperability between SD\-WAN, cloud security, identity management, observability, and enterprise systems.


**AI \& Operational Excellence**
* Lead AI\-driven automation initiatives across fulfilment, assurance, security operations, and customer support functions.
* Utilize AI/ML capabilities to improve incident prediction, root cause analysis, security posture management, and operational intelligence.
* Drive automation\-led reduction in manual operational effort and improved service reliability.
* Establish KPIs and governance frameworks for automation maturity and customer experience improvements.


**Stakeholder \& Delivery Leadership**
* Collaborate with Product, Security, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Commercial teams to drive portfolio outcomes.
* Conduct business requirement analysis, solution assessments, impact analysis, estimation, and investment planning.
* Lead leadership reviews, customer demonstrations, architecture governance, PI planning, UAT governance, and program steering committees.
* Manage strategic relationships with technology partners, vendors, and cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in Telecom, Networking, Cloud Security, SASE, and Software Product Engineering domains.
* Proven expertise in L2O, O2C/O2B, and T2R process transformation within telecom, networking, or managed security services environments.
* Strong experience in SASE technologies including:
+ SD\-WAN
+ Secure Service Edge (SSE)
+ Secure Internet Access

* Experience with service orchestration, provisioning automation, and lifecycle management platforms.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies including WAN, LAN, MPLS, Internet, Routing, Switching, SD\-WAN, and Cloud Connectivity.
* Experience in API\-first architectures, cloud platforms, automation frameworks, and AI\-enabled operational models.
* Strong exposure to OSS/BSS ecosystems and integration architectures.
* Experience leading enterprise\-scale transformation programs and customer journey modernization initiatives.


**Preferred Technical Expertise**
**SASE \& Security Technologies**
* Cisco Secure Access
* Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela)
* Palo Alto Prisma SASE
* Netskope
* Zscaler
* Fortinet SASE
* SSE Platforms


**Networking \& Connectivity**
* SD\-WAN
* MPLS
* Routing \& Switching
* Hybrid Connectivity
* Internet \& Cloud Connectivity
* Software Defined Networking (SDN)


**Service Orchestration \& Automation**

* Service Lifecycle Management
* Network Automation Frameworks


**OSS/BSS \& Digital Platforms**
* Salesforce (SFDC)
* ServiceNow
* SAP S/4HANA
* Order Management Platforms
* CRM
* Inventory, Assurance \& Billing Systems
* TM Forum Open APIs
* Open Digital Architecture (ODA)


**Cloud \& AI Technologies**
* AWS
* Azure
* Google Cloud
* Container \& Kubernetes Platforms
* AI/ML\-powered Operations
* AIOps
* Observability Platforms
* Security Analytics \& Automation


**Desirable Experience**
* Minimum 5 years as Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Digital Product Manager, or Portfolio Lead within SASE, Managed Security, SD\-WAN, Enterprise Connectivity, or Security Services domains.
* Experience with SAFe Agile delivery models including PI Planning, Release Train Management, Portfolio Governance, and Backlog Prioritization.
* Experience managing product investments, engineering budgets, business cases, and benefit realization.
* Proven experience in EPIC management, journey mapping, portfolio planning, and strategic roadmap development.
* Strong experience driving cross\-functional alignment across OSS/BSS platforms, orchestration systems, cloud environments, and security platforms.
* Experience in onboarding security services onto automated fulfilment and orchestration platforms.
* Exposure to AI\-driven security operations, AIOps, and cloud\-native service delivery environments.


**Core Competencies**
* SASE Portfolio Management \& Strategy
* Product Engineering \& Service Lifecycle Management
* SD\-WAN \& Secure Access Services
* L2O, O2C/O2B \& T2R Transformation
* Service Orchestration \& Automation
* Zero\-Touch Provisioning \& MACD Automation
* OSS/BSS Architecture \& Transformation
* Cloud Security \& Enterprise Networking
* AI \& Digital Transformation Leadership
* Portfolio Governance \& Roadmap Management
* SAFe Agile Delivery \& PI Planning
* Stakeholder \& Executive Management


**Success Measures**
* Reduction in L2O, O2C/O2B, and T2R cycle times for SASE services.
* Increased automation and straight\-through provisioning rates.
* Successful onboarding of SASE products onto orchestration and fulfilment platforms.
* Expansion of Zero\-Touch deployment and MACD capabilities.
* Improved customer onboarding, activation, and service assurance KPIs.
* Growth in SASE adoption, customer retention, and portfolio revenues.
* Increased API utilization, orchestration maturity, and operational efficiency.
* Enhanced AI\-driven operational outcomes and service reliability.
* Successful execution of portfolio roadmaps, PI objectives, and transformation initiatives.
* Improved customer experience and business outcomes across the SASE service portfolio.

If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Product Analyst – Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 The Business Analyst cum Product Analyst analyzes business systems, processes, and data to engineer solutions that enhance business capabilities and operational efficiency. As a core member of the product team, this role translates business workflows into clear technical requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria. The analyst also functions as a proxy product owner and subject matter expert, collaborating closely with business stakeholders and technical teams. A strong foundation in requirements engineering, process modeling, Agile practices, and data analysis is essential.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Requirements \& Product Analysis**
* Translate business processes, goals, and terminology into technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a proxy product owner for designated business domains, offering functional expertise and guidance.
* Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to analyze, document, and refine product requirements.
* Manage and prioritize product backlog items in Azure DevOps based on business value, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs.
* Prepare communications, presentations, and documentation on system enhancements, alternatives, and recommended solutions.


**Process \& Data Analysis**
* Analyze business workflows to identify opportunities for process improvement, efficiency gains, and automation.
* Validate, interpret, and analyze data from Mainframe environments, DB2 databases, and SQL queries to support decision\-making.
* Contribute to building business cases by gathering data, identifying issues, and documenting components under senior guidance.


**Agile Delivery \& Project Support**
* Support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Develop schedules of tasks based on overarching project timelines and keep stakeholders informed on progress.
* Participate in system testing, UAT, and production validation to ensure solution accuracy and quality.
* Work independently on projects of low to moderate complexity and with minimal supervision on more complex initiatives.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build, maintain, and enhance strong relationships with business partners through active listening, consistent communication, and accountability.
* Understand stakeholder needs and expectations to deliver clear, value\-driven solutions.
* Demonstrate trust, influence, and adaptability to meet evolving business requirements.


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Create business and functional requirement documents, process flows, guidelines, and technical communication materials.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and metrics using Microsoft Office tools to track product performance and project progress.
* Seek relevant information to ensure clarity and accuracy of technical communication tailored to different audience groups.


**Continuous Improvement \& Strategy Execution**
* Apply an understanding of financial, ROI, and market principles to support strategy development.
* Identify inefficiencies within work processes and apply innovative ideas or established tools to improve outcomes.
* Continuously pursue opportunities for system, workflow, and product improvements.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Proven experience as a Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role (5–8 years preferred).
* Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps for managing requirements and product backlogs.
* Experience with Mainframe systems, DB2 databases, SQL, and data validation.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/SAFe) and cross\-functional team collaboration.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio).
* Exposure to PL/SQL, EDI Mapping, enterprise integration, and data flows across legacy and modern platforms.
* Core competencies: requirements elicitation, process modeling, workshop facilitation, and analytical thinking.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong stakeholder management ability.
* High attention to detail, strong organizational and time\-management skills, and a problem\-solving mindset.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Combination of university education and hands\-on business/domain experience is valued

 Permanent

title: Product Analyst
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. The Business Analyst will analyze our requirements and design solutions to meet those requirements. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Elicits, analyzes, specifies, and validates the business needs of stakeholders, be they customers or end users.
* Collaborates with project sponsors to determine project scope and vision.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Identifies and establishes scope and parameters of requirements analysis on a project\-by\-project basis to define project impact, outcome criteria, and metrics.
* Works with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Researches, reviews, and analyses the effectiveness of existing requirements\-gathering processes and develop strategies for enhancing or further applying these processes.
* Helps conduct research on products to meet agreed upon requirements and to support purchasing efforts.
* Participates in the QA of solutions to ensure features and functions have been enabled and optimized.
* Participates in the selection of any requirements documentation software solutions that the organization may opt to use.
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Develops and utilizes standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Creates process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
* Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicates changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — verbally or through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* You will report to manager \- IT


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
   

  

 Typically requires 8 years of related experience (project Management, Process Improvement and data management experience)
   

  

 Communicate the plan and priorities for the Program Increment and define the PI goals
   

  

 Drive release behavior, incenting discipline and quality over speed
   

  

 Determine resource requirements and partner with Tech Lead or Business Owner on sourcing talent
   

  

 Integrates change management elements needed to support the desired state;
   

  

 Track key delivery issues and risks and escalating as needed.
   

  

 Accountable for validation of acceptance criteria met before accepting completed features and definition of done
   

  

 Overall responsibility to manage the Epic and Feature backlogs and Themes for measuring to key objectives, value delivery.
   

  

 Collaborate and shape design, development and implementation requirements with partners and engineering team members.
   

  

 Be responsible for training and support documentation, as well as business readiness \& service transition
   

  

 Provides consultative support in financial management, organizational change, vendor management, and operational excellence to business lead technology initiatives and to our business or enterprise shared services teams
   

  

 Provide analysis on key business drivers and metrics using the latest analytics \& visualization technology.
   

  

 Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).
   

  

 Proven experience with business and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modeling, verification, and methodology development
   

  

 Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including planning and organizing
   

  

 You will report toTeam Lead \-IT
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
