title: Assistant Manager – Revenue (Chennai)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Product Owner
description:
Product Owner
   

  

 Location: Chennai
   

 Experience: 4–6 Years
   

 Work Mode: Face\-to\-Face / On\-site
   

 Shift Timing: 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM
   

 Notice Period: Maximum 15 Days
   

 CTC: Up to ₹15 LPA
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to manage and drive the product lifecycle from requirements gathering and business analysis through development, delivery, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Requirements Gathering, Agile/Scrum, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Backlog Management, Stakeholder Management, and Product Documentation.
   

  

 Candidates with an educational or professional background in BBA, B.Com, Accounting, Finance, Business Management, or related domains are preferred.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- Own and manage the product lifecycle from requirements gathering through delivery and continuous improvement.
   

 \- Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements from stakeholders.
   

 \- Translate business requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
   

 \- Create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on business priorities and product objectives.
   

 \- Work closely with development, QA, design, and business teams to ensure successful product delivery.
   

 \- Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
   

 \- Use JIRA to manage user stories, requirements, tasks, and product backlog.
   

 \- Work with design teams using Figma to review wireframes, user flows, and product designs.
   

 \- Analyze business and product data to support informed product decisions.
   

 \- Prepare and maintain functional and technical documentation.
   

 \- Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to track progress, manage dependencies, and resolve issues.
   

 \- Define and communicate product priorities, roadmap requirements, and release plans.
   

 \- Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure delivered features meet defined acceptance criteria.
   

 \- Gather stakeholder feedback and identify opportunities for product enhancement and continuous improvement.
   

 \- Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure clear communication and successful product delivery.
   

  

 Required Skills \& Experience
   

  

 \- 4–6 years of relevant experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or a similar role.
   

 \- Strong experience in requirements gathering and business analysis.
   

 \- Hands\-on experience creating user stories and acceptance criteria.
   

 \- Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
   

 \- Hands\-on experience with JIRA and product backlog management.
   

 \- Working knowledge of Figma, wireframes, and user flows.
   

 \- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
   

 \- Experience in data analysis and using business insights for product decisions.
   

 \- Strong functional and technical documentation skills.
   

 \- Good project management, coordination, and problem\-solving skills.
   

 \- Ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams.
   

  

 Preferred Educational / Professional Background
   

  

 Candidates with an educational or professional background in:
   

  

 \- BBA

 \- Accounting
   

 \- Finance
   

 \- Business Management
   

 \- Related business or accounting domains
   

  

 Candidates with previous experience as a Product Owner, Product Team Lead, Business Analyst, or similar product\-focused role will be preferred.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber helps clients navigate an increasingly complex and fast\-changing threat landscape. We simplify complexity, strengthen resilience, and enable organizations to grow with confidence while proactively managing cybersecurity risk.
   

  

**The Team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering team is building the technology foundation for the next generation of cybersecurity services. We bring together product thinking, engineering depth, and cybersecurity domain expertise to design and deploy modern platforms and AI\-enabled solutions for our clients. Join us as we build future\-ready capabilities with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 As a
 **Cyber Forward Deployed Engineering Manager** 
 , you will operate at the intersection of client delivery, engineering execution, and solution shaping. You will lead cross\-functional teams to design, build, and deploy high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions in client environments. This role requires strong technical depth, delivery ownership, and the ability to translate ambiguous business and cybersecurity needs into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
   

  

 You will be expected to manage workstreams end\-to\-end, guide architecture and engineering decisions, mentor engineers, and engage directly with client stakeholders to drive outcomes. You will also play a key role in pursuits, prototypes, and product feedback loops that shape reusable capabilities across Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering offerings.
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills**
**Core Engineering \& Architecture**
* 9–15 years of hands\-on experience in software engineering, including meaningful experience leading full\-stack engineering teams and complex technical deliveries.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Next.js.
* Strong backend development experience in Node.js, Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), or Java (Spring Boot).
* Experience designing and delivering scalable applications using relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL technologies (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
* Deep experience building and integrating REST APIs, microservices, event\-driven services, and serverless architectures.
* Experience architecting and deploying cloud\-native applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based workflows, and engineering lifecycle tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Ability to make sound architecture decisions, evaluate trade\-offs, and enforce engineering quality, security, and maintainability standards.


**AI / GenAI Capabilities**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building and deploying GenAI, LLM, or agentic AI solutions in client, enterprise, or production environments.
* Experience with at least one frontier GenAI platform such as Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI, including hands\-on use of products such as Claude API, Claude Code, Gemini API, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Grounding, GPT\-4o, Responses API, Assistants API, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Strong understanding of AI application architectures, including orchestration, grounding, prompt workflows, model integration, evaluation, security, and operationalization.
* Ability to align application design and engineering pipelines to support AI\-enabled use cases in secure, scalable production settings.


**Client Leadership \& Delivery Ownership**
* Proven ability to independently lead defined workstreams or products end\-to\-end with high\-quality, timely delivery.
* Experience working directly with senior business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into architecture, roadmaps, and delivered solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, reviewing designs and code, and driving accountability across delivery teams.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on client outcomes, delivery rigor, and continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Familiarity with cybersecurity domains such as application security, cloud security, identity, SOC engineering, detection engineering, or cyber analytics.
* Experience in product engineering or platform engineering environments.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle.
* Exposure to search and analytics platforms such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and graph databases such as Neo4j.
* Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code, and advanced cloud\-native engineering patterns.
* Cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Experience supporting proposals, technical demos, proofs of concept, or early\-stage solution shaping in consulting or client\-facing environments.


**Work You Will Do**
* Solution Delivery \& Engineering Leadership
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions aligned to client requirements, enterprise architecture, and security expectations.
* Own technical delivery across one or more workstreams, including planning, architecture, issue resolution, quality management, and execution oversight.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Identify technical risks, delivery dependencies, and design trade\-offs early, and drive mitigation plans to maintain delivery confidence.
* Establish and uphold engineering best practices across code quality, documentation, testing, observability, and security.
* Client Engagement \& Solution Shaping
* Partner with client stakeholders to define technical approaches, clarify requirements, and shape pragmatic, scalable solutions to cybersecurity challenges.
* Support pursuits and pre\-sales efforts through technical storytelling, demos, prototypes, architecture inputs, and feasibility assessments.
* Influence solution direction by balancing client priorities, engineering practicality, cybersecurity requirements, and reusable platform opportunities.
* Act as a trusted technical leader who can bridge business goals and engineering execution.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Mentor and develop engineers through coaching, design reviews, and day\-to\-day delivery leadership.
* Promote a strong team culture centered on accountability, collaboration, learning, and engineering excellence.
* Help teams adopt delivery discipline, reusable patterns, and effective operating rhythms to improve execution quality and speed.
* Product Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
* Capture delivery insights and translate them into reusable product, platform, or engineering improvements.
* Distinguish between client\-specific customization and scalable enhancements that can strengthen Deloitte’s broader Cyber Engineering capabilities.
* Enable client teams and internal teams through structured knowledge transfer, practical documentation, and durable runbooks.


**Education**

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

**About Avaz** 





 Avaz AAC is an Augmentative and Alternative Communication app that gives children and adults with disabilities such as autism, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, aphasia, and apraxia a voice of their own to communicate and build meaningful connections. Avaz AAC is a picture\- and text\-based communication app designed for children and adults with complex communication needs.
 





 Our mission is to make effective communication accessible to every person who needs it. Achieving this requires us to understand communicators and their support networks deeply, translate that understanding into reliable products, and continuously improve the communication experience.
 




  





**About the team** 





 We are a team of passionate individuals working towards a more accessible and inclusive world where everyone has the opportunity to communicate and be heard. Our team brings together product management, design, engineering, QA, clinical content, customer support and marketing, with empathy at the centre of how we work.
 





 We create space for fresh ideas, different perspectives and thoughtful experimentation. Team members are encouraged to question assumptions, explore new approaches and learn directly from the people who use our products. We believe meaningful innovation comes from combining curiosity, open collaboration and a deep understanding of our users.
 




  





**What you’ll do** 





 Own the end\-to\-end development of features within Avaz AAC, from customer discovery and problem definition through requirements, execution, release, measurement, and iteration.
 





 You will establish continuous customer touchpoints, use qualitative and quantitative evidence to identify high\-impact opportunities, and drive cross\-functional execution across the Avaz team.
 




  





**Role and Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end development of features within Avaz AAC, from problem discovery and definition to execution, release and iteration.
* Learn deeply from users and data through customer calls, interviews, usability studies, beta programmes, and product metrics, then use what you find to spot the biggest opportunities and measure impact.
* Turn needs, data, and company priorities into clear PRDs, specs, and acceptance criteria, and use quick flows and low\-fi prototypes in Figma to share ideas and gather feedback before building.
* Decide what to build and in what order, balancing competing needs, then drive it to launch by partnering across engineering, design, QA, clinical content, support, and marketing.
* Manage feature and release execution, including scope, dependencies, beta testing, release readiness, stakeholder communication, launch coordination and post\-launch improvement.
* Maintain an understanding of the AAC market and wider industry. Periodically review comparable products and relevant trends to inform product decisions.



  





**Skills and Attributes** 



* 4\+ years of product management experience, including taking software features from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Strong analytical and first\-principles problem\-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and make evidence\-based decisions.
* Ability to develop a deep understanding of users, including their goals, behaviours, contexts and constraints, and translate that understanding into thoughtful product decisions.
* Experience using qualitative customer research and quantitative product data to identify opportunities and measure outcomes.
* An iterative working style, with a willingness to test assumptions early, incorporate feedback and improve products through successive releases.
* Strong collaborator and communicator who drives execution and keeps cross\-functional stakeholders aligned.



  





**Good to have** 



* Experience in AAC, assistive technology, accessibility, health technology, special education, or another product area serving people with diverse needs.
* Experience building consumer mobile applications or products used by multiple user groups.
* Familiarity with multilingual products, offline or low\-connectivity use cases, accessibility\-sensitive workflows, or privacy\-sensitive customer research.

title: Director, FCSO Screening Product Manager - List Management
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Director, FCSO Screening Product Management supports the ED, Head of FCSO Screening Products in the strategic management, development, implementation, enhancement and ongoing maintenance of the Bank's Screening Products and associated capabilities with a specific focus on List Management.
   

  

 The primary focus of the role is to drive effective List product management practices across the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring that products remain fit for purpose, regulatory compliant, operationally efficient and aligned to the Bank's financial crime risk management objectives. This includes ownership of List product roadmaps, prioritisation of enhancements, management of product backlogs, oversight of defect remediation, implementation of new capabilities and establishment of feedback loops to continuously improve product performance and outcomes.
   

  

 The role holder partners closely with Operations, Technology, Data and Financial Crime stakeholders to identify opportunities to strengthen screening controls, improve screening effectiveness and support the safe introduction of new List products. A key objective of the role is to improve the earlier identification of financial crime risk through enhanced List Management capabilities, improved data utilisation, more effective alert generation and optimisation of Screening processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**
* Drive the strategic development and evolution of the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring products remain effective, scalable, compliant and aligned to the Bank's financial crime risk management objectives.
* Define and execute product roadmaps that enhance screening capabilities, accelerate the implementation of regulatory and sanctions requirements, and support the introduction of new products, customer segments, geographies and payment flows.
* Champion a product\-led approach to continuous improvement through performance monitoring, user feedback, outcome analysis and data\-driven prioritisation of enhancements, fixes and optimisation initiatives.
* Drive improvements that enable earlier identification of financial crime risk by enhancing screening logic, data quality, alert quality and overall risk\-detection effectiveness while reducing false positives and unnecessary operational effort.
* Maintain awareness of emerging financial crime threats, regulatory developments, industry best practices and technological advancements to identify opportunities to strengthen screening products and improve risk outcomes across the Bank.


**Business**
* Own and govern the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring capabilities, configurations, controls and supporting documentation remain effective, compliant and aligned to business and regulatory requirements.
* Lead the assessment, prioritisation and delivery of product enhancements, new screening use cases, onboarding initiatives and change requests, ensuring solutions support effective financial crime risk management across products, channels, customer segments and geographies.
* Establish and maintain robust product governance, including management of regulatory commitments, audit actions, operational risk obligations, procedures, standards and control frameworks relevant to Screening Products.
* Monitor product performance and outcomes through defined metrics, stakeholder engagement and operational feedback loops, driving continual improvements to screening effectiveness, alert quality, data quality and user experience.
* Act as a subject matter expert on Screening Products, translating emerging financial crime threats, regulatory developments and industry best practices into product enhancements that improve risk detection, accelerate regulatory responsiveness and reduce unnecessary operational effort.


**Leadership and Management**
* Champion a product\-led culture across the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring focus remains on improving risk detection outcomes, regulatory compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Lead and influence stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology and CFCC to deliver product enhancements, strategic change initiatives and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Drive a data\-driven approach to product management, leveraging performance metrics, user feedback and operational insights to enhance screening effectiveness, reduce false positives and enable earlier identification of financial crime risk.


**Knowledge Development and Information Management**
* Develop and maintain meaningful product and risk MI, KPIs and performance metrics to measure Screening Product effectiveness, identify trends and support data\-driven decision making.
* Analyse product performance, stakeholder feedback and operational outcomes to identify opportunities for optimisation, enhancement and improved risk detection.
* Promote effective knowledge sharing and documentation of product changes, lessons learned, industry developments and regulatory expectations to support continuous improvement across the Screening Product portfolio.


**Stakeholders Relations**
* Build and maintain strong partnerships across Operations, Technology, Data and CFCC stakeholders to ensure Screening Product priorities, enhancements and outcomes remain aligned to business needs, regulatory expectations and financial crime risk objectives.
* Represent the Screening Product function in engagements with regulators, industry forums, peer institutions and strategic vendors, leveraging external insights and best practices to inform product strategy and drive continuous improvement.


**Process**
* Establish and maintain robust product governance processes covering the prioritisation, design, testing, implementation and ongoing maintenance of Screening Products, ensuring solutions remain effective, compliant and fit for purpose.
* Define and oversee product lifecycle management standards, including change management, defect remediation, performance monitoring, feedback loops and continuous improvement activities across the Screening Product portfolio.
* Ensure product controls, configurations, supporting documentation and operating procedures are maintained in line with regulatory requirements, Group standards and financial crime risk management objectives.


**People \& Talent**
* Foster a high\-performance, product\-led culture that encourages innovation, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement across the Screening Product function.
* Develop team capabilities in product management, screening technologies, data\-driven decision making and financial crime risk management to support evolving business and regulatory requirements.
* Provide clear leadership, coaching and direction to ensure roles, responsibilities and priorities are well understood, enabling effective delivery of product outcomes and strategic objectives.


**Risk Management**
* Own and oversee financial crime risks associated with Screening Products, ensuring capabilities, configurations and controls remain effective in identifying sanctions, AML and other financial crime risks across customers, transactions and products
* Drive continuous optimisation of screening effectiveness through analysis of risk outcomes, alert quality, data quality and system performance, improving risk detection while reducing false positives and operational inefficiencies.
* Assess and manage risks arising from new products, customer segments, payment flows, geographies and regulatory requirements, ensuring appropriate screening controls are designed and implemented.
* Maintain oversight of key screening data, watchlists, regulatory content and product configurations to ensure screening solutions remain current, accurate and aligned to evolving risk and regulatory expectations.
* Strengthen the operational resilience of Screening Products through effective risk management, control monitoring, issue remediation, incident management and governance processes, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of material risks and control weaknesses.


**Governance**
* Establish and maintain effective governance over the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring clear accountability, oversight and reporting of product strategy, performance, risks, issues and change initiatives.
* Oversee the identification, tracking, escalation and remediation of product, operational and financial crime risk issues, ensuring timely resolution of audit findings, regulatory actions, incidents and control weaknesses.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement by capturing, communicating and embedding lessons learned from audits, assurance reviews, incidents, regulatory feedback and product performance reviews into future product enhancements and control design.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Help to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Operation of Financial Markets; Financial Crime Prevention; The Right Environment
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

* FCSO List Management,
* FCSO TS and NS Product Owners
* FCSO Screening Operations
* FCSO Global Process Owners (and delegates)
* FCSO Technology
* Group Risk Framework Owners

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in FCSO, GBS India / OPS FCSO Screening/ FCSO Product Management; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;


**Skills And Experience**
* Compliance Policies and Standards
* Compliance Advisory
* Surveillance (including Screening and Monitoring)
* Investigations
* Compliance Risk Assessment

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C\-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade\-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI\-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision\-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine\-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**
* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI\-enabled digital transformation, data \& AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.


**Preferred:**
* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**

In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of modern data platforms, generative AI, and intelligent automation while collaborating across business and technology teams to shape scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. title: Product Owner 2
description:
**Summary:**



 We are looking for a highly motivated Technical Product Owner with 4\-6 years of experience in Agile product development and enterprise software delivery. The ideal candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, engineering teams, and customers to translate business needs into well\-defined technical solutions. This role requires a strong understanding of Java\-based backend services, cloud\-native architectures on AWS, APIs, microservices, and system integrations. The Technical Product Owner will serve as the bridge between business requirements and technical implementation, ensuring that business features are decomposed into actionable technical features and user stories with sufficient service\-level and component\-level detail for efficient development and delivery.
 




**Responsibilities:**
* Define and communicate the product vision, goals, roadmap, and desired business outcomes.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring prioritization aligns with business objectives, architectural direction, delivery capacity, and technical dependencies.
* Gather, analyze, and document business, functional, technical, and non\-functional requirements.
* Partner with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to translate business capabilities into technical features and implementation\-ready user stories.
* Decompose business features into technical features, enablers, backend services, integrations, and platform capabilities.
* Create user stories that include business context, high\-level service and component details, affected systems, component interactions, integration points, dependencies, API or event requirements, data considerations, and acceptance criteria.
* Understand and document backend service interactions, data flows, interface contracts, upstream and downstream dependencies, and integration requirements.
* Work closely with engineering teams to understand solution approaches for Java and Spring Boot microservices deployed on AWS.
* Collaborate with architects and developers to understand service contracts, REST API requirements, event\-driven workflows, and integration patterns.
* Ensure user stories capture relevant non\-functional expectations, including security, performance, scalability, availability, observability, error handling, resiliency, and supportability.
* Facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical teams to resolve functional and technical ambiguities.
* Evaluate technical trade\-offs, implementation risks, dependencies, and sequencing considerations during backlog prioritization and release planning.
* Lead or actively participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, architecture discussions, and release planning.
* Ensure stories meet the Definition of Ready and provide timely clarifications throughout the sprint.
* Validate completed work against functional and technical acceptance criteria and approve user stories.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, product demonstrations, release readiness, and product launches.
* Monitor product performance, operational feedback, adoption, and business impact to drive continuous improvement.
* Identify risks, blockers, and cross\-team dependencies and work proactively with stakeholders to resolve them.
* Promote Agile best practices, engineering collaboration, and customer\-centric product development.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Business Analyst, or related product role in software delivery.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and SAFe methodologies.
* Experience managing product backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, Rally, or similar tools.
* Proven ability to translate business features into technical features, user stories, and clear acceptance criteria.
* Strong understanding of backend application architecture, microservices, REST APIs, service\-oriented architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience working with engineering teams developing Java and Spring Boot backend services on AWS.
* Ability to understand high\-level solution architecture and convert business requirements into implementable technical deliverables.
* Ability to analyze system interactions, data models, service dependencies, and integration requirements.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native development, CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, observability, and cloud deployment models.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to balance business priorities, customer needs, technical constraints, risks, and delivery timelines.


**Required Skills:**
* Technical Product Ownership and Product Backlog Management
* Business\-to\-Technical Feature Decomposition
* Java and Spring Boot Fundamentals
* AWS Cloud Architecture and Cloud\-Native Development
* Microservices, REST APIs, and System Integrations
* Service and Component Modeling
* Event\-Driven Architecture
* Technical User Story and Acceptance Criteria Creation
* Non\-Functional Requirements Definition
* Agile, Scrum, and SAFe Delivery
* Azure DevOps, Jira, and Confluence
* Stakeholder Management, Communication, and Negotiation
* Risk, Dependency, and Release Management
* Customer\-Centric Product Thinking


**Preferred Skills:**
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager certification.
* Working knowledge of AWS services such as API Gateway, Lambda, ECS or EKS, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, RDS, Step Functions, CloudWatch, and IAM.

 Growth Product Managers at Matrimony.com are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by optimizing the customer journey across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, referral, and monetization. They leverage customer insights, data analytics, experimentation, and product innovation to identify growth opportunities and improve key business metrics.
 



 As the voice of the customer and the business, Growth Product Managers work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, CRM, and Business teams to build and optimize product experiences that accelerate user growth and maximize customer lifetime value across mobile apps, mobile web, and desktop platforms.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Growth Strategy \& Execution** 



* Own and drive key growth metrics across the customer lifecycle, including acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, referral, and revenue.
* Identify growth opportunities through customer research, behavioral analysis, funnel diagnostics, and market intelligence.
* Develop growth hypotheses and design data\-driven experiments to improve conversion and business outcomes.
* Create and maintain a growth roadmap aligned with business objectives and customer needs.



  





**Product \& Experimentation** 



* Define product requirements and work with UX teams to create wireframes, prototypes, and optimized user journeys.
* Lead A/B testing and experimentation initiatives to validate ideas and drive continuous product improvement.
* Optimize onboarding, engagement, subscription, and monetization funnels through iterative product enhancements.
* Drive personalization and recommendation strategies to improve user experience and conversion rates.



  





**Data \& Analytics** 



* Partner with Analytics teams to establish measurement frameworks, track KPIs, and generate actionable insights.
* Monitor product performance and growth metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend corrective actions.
* Use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize opportunities and influence product decisions.



  





**Cross\-functional Leadership** 



* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Marketing, CRM, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success teams to execute growth initiatives.
* Ensure seamless alignment between product strategy, customer experience, and business goals.
* Drive end\-to\-end execution and delivery of growth\-focused product initiatives.



  





**Customer \& Market Understanding** 



* Develop a deep understanding of customer behavior, motivations, and pain points.
* Stay updated on industry trends, consumer internet best practices, competitor strategies, and emerging growth techniques.
* Champion customer\-centric product thinking across the organization.



  





**Skill and Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of growth frameworks including Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, and Revenue (AARRR).
* Deep customer empathy and ability to translate insights into scalable product solutions.
* Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in data interpretation and experimentation methodologies.
* Experience in A/B testing, funnel optimization, cohort analysis, and growth experimentation.
* Excellent problem\-solving and structured thinking skills.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance customer experience and commercial outcomes.
* Ability to independently drive initiatives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Understanding of consumer internet products, mobile ecosystems, and digital marketing channels.
* Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics, or similar platforms.



  





**Education and Experience** 



* Engineering Graduate with MBA from a reputed institution preferred.
* 3–6 years of experience in Product Management, Growth Product Management, or Digital Product roles within Consumer Internet, E\-commerce, Marketplace, Subscription, SaaS, Dating, Social, or Digital Platform businesses.
* Proven track record of driving measurable improvements in customer acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, or revenue metrics.
* Experience working in high\-growth startups or consumer technology companies will be preferred.



  





**About Matrimony.com** 




 Matrimony.com Ltd, a Great Place to Work Certified Wed\-Tech company listed on the BSE and NSE, is a leader in matchmaking and wedding services. Its flagship brand, Bharat Matrimony, is the largest and most trusted matrimony brand (Brand Trust Report 2014\) spanning customers across the entire economic strata. The company serves over 8 million members with the support of 3,000\+ associates and a network of 130\+ company\-owned retail outlets.
 



  





**Key Offerings:** 




  





**Matchmaking Services:** 



* **BharatMatrimony and 200\+ matrimony brands** 
 segmented on religion, languages, communities, and occupation.

 An exclusive matchmaking app for non\-degree holders in 9 Indian languages

 Largest wedding services provider.

**New Initiatives \& Verticals**

description:

 The Org Excellence (OE) team within RBS Business Excellence is seeking a Senior Product Manager (Non\-Tech) to own the product vision, strategy, and cross\-functional delivery of scalable AI\-aided solutions that serve Business Excellence programs and are designed for reuse across Amazon.
   

  

 This role combines product strategy with AI fluency and cross\-organisational delivery — owning the end\-to\-end customer experience of complex, multi\-stakeholder programs that turn OE’s operational expertise into productised, self\-service tooling. You will own a portfolio of 5 AI\-aided solutions, define the roadmap, drive customer adoption, and partner with RBS Tech for engineering execution — without managing a dedicated engineering team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI\-aided OE solutions (PEX AI Career Coach, CI Platform, AI Agent Knowledge Management, Unified Innovation Platform)
* Define and prioritise features by working backward from customer needs; write product requirements (BRDs/PRFAQs) that are clear, actionable, and measurable
* Partner with RBS Tech (AI architecture \& engineering) to translate product vision into delivered solutions leveraging existing funded engineering teams
* Drive cross\-org adoption strategy — identify early adopters, run pilots, measure outcomes, and scale solutions to other Amazon orgs (Ops, CS, AWS)
* Conduct user research, competitive benchmarking, and data analysis to identify opportunities and validate product\-market fit for internal AI tools
* Build POCs and prototypes using AI tools directly (agentic workflows, prompt engineering, no\-code/low\-code) to de\-risk ideas before committing engineering resources
* Establish success metrics (adoption, NPS, time\-saved, cost\-avoidance) and reporting mechanisms; present progress in MBRs/QBRs with data\-driven narratives
* Own agent governance policy — define reuse standards, lifecycle management rules, and discovery mechanisms for AI agents across RBS
* Influence strategic direction across Business Excellence, working with senior leadership to align product investments with organizational priorities
* Manage stakeholder relationships across multiple BUs, balancing competing priorities while maintaining a coherent product strategy


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Master's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or Master's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
* Experience working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

title: Senior Product Manager II - Identity & Access Management
description:
Here at Appian, our values of
 **Intensity** 
 and
 **Excellence** 
 define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.
 



*Own the Identity and Access Management product roadmap and deliver enterprise\-grade authentication features that secure every connection between Appian and the enterprise.* 




  
 



**ABOUT THE TEAM** 




 The IAM Product team is on a mission to secure every identity, authentication flow, and access point that connects Appian to the enterprise. This team operates with high autonomy and directly influences how global enterprises trust and deploy AI\-Powered Process Automation at scale. Your work will define how millions of users authenticate securely across mission\-critical workflows.
 



  
 



**THE OPPORTUNITY** 




 As enterprises accelerate digital transformation, identity security has become the frontline of platform trust. This role exists because Appian is scaling its authentication and authorization capabilities to meet zero trust demands from the world's most security\-conscious organizations. You will shape how the platform handles federated identity, modern protocols, and seamless user experiences in highly regulated environments.
 



  
 



**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end IAM product roadmap, defining priorities that balance enterprise security requirements with developer and end\-user experience
* Partner with Engineering to evaluate, design, and enhance authentication and authorization capabilities including native authentication and support for SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, and federated identity frameworks
* Execute discovery and requirements gathering with enterprise customers to understand identity provider integrations, compliance needs, and zero trust adoption patterns
* Architect product specifications and user stories that translate complex identity protocols into intuitive, scalable platform features
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with Security, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver authentication features that accelerate enterprise adoption
* Analyze product performance metrics, customer feedback, and competitive positioning to continuously improve IAM capabilities and reduce friction in authentication flows


  
 
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
* 4\+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager with a proven track record of successfully managing products that involve identity and access management
* Deep experience with identity and access management, user authentication, or identity provider software in enterprise environments
* Strong technical proficiency with authentication protocols including SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, and federated identity architectures
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver secure, scalable authentication solutions


  
 
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Knowledge of zero trust architecture principles and implementation strategies
* Experience working with cloud identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, or Auth0
* Background in cybersecurity, compliance frameworks, or enterprise security product management
* We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise\-Grade Orchestration environment.



**This role is based at our Chennai office in DLF Downtown Chennai.** 
**Appian was built on a culture of in\-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. Employees hired for this position are expected to be in the office 5 days a week to foster that culture and ensure we continue to thrive through shared ideas and teamwork. We believe being in the office provides more opportunities to come together and celebrate working with the exceptional people across Appian.** 
   
 




**Tools and Resources** 




* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department\-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First\-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee\-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.



**Benefits**




 Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family\-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.
 




**About Appian** 





 Appian provides AI automation for mission\-critical work. We automate complex processes in large enterprises and governments. Our platform is known for its unique reliability and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and understand enterprise operations like no one else. For more information, visit appian.com. \[Nasdaq: APPN]
 



 Follow Appian: LinkedIn, Youtube, Instagram, Facebook

title: MBA Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 Strategic Ventures is a growth strategy consulting firm focused on advising and promoting technology\-driven businesses. The firm helps clients identify and leverage their unique value drivers, enabling them to outperform competitors and enhance shareholder returns. Strategic Ventures works closely with leadership teams to translate strategic insights into practical growth plans. Applicants can expect an environment that values analytical thinking, innovation, and measurable impact on client performance.
 



  




 MBA Intern – Healthcare Consulting
 
 We’re hiring MBA interns (Marketing or Technology Management) to explore and execute consulting opportunities with hospitals and healthcare providers. This is a fully remote, paid, task\- and performance\-based internship ideal for candidates who want hands\-on experience in healthcare consulting, business development, and operational improvement.
 


 About the Role
 
 As a Healthcare Consulting Intern, you will work directly with hospital leadership and our internal team to identify, analyze, and execute high\-impact projects in areas such as revenue cycle optimization, patient acquisition, digital transformation, and service\-line growth. You’ll operate like a junior consultant: scoping problems, running analyses, building recommendations, and supporting implementation—remotely.
 


 Who Should Apply
 * Current MBA students or recent graduates (0–12 months) with a specialization in
 
 Marketing
 
 or
 
 Technology/Operations Management
 
 .
* Strong interest in
 
 healthcare
 
 ,
 
 consulting
 
 , and
 
 problem\-solving
 
 .
* Comfortable working remotely with hospital administrators, clinicians, and cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to create clear, client\-ready decks and reports.
* Analytical mindset: comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, basic data visualization, and structured thinking.
* Self\-starter who can own tasks end\-to\-end with minimal supervision.


 Key Responsibilities
 
 You will be assigned discrete workstreams and client tasks. Typical responsibilities include:
 


* Opportunity Exploration
* Research hospital markets, service lines, and competitor benchmarks.
* Identify consulting opportunities
* Client Engagement \& Requirements
* Conduct remote interviews with hospital stakeholders to clarify objectives and pain points.
* Document business requirements and translate them into project charters and work plans.
* Analysis \& Recommendations
* Analyze operational, financial, and marketing data
* Build hypotheses, run analyses, and synthesize insights into actionable recommendations.
* Deliverables
* Create client\-facing presentations, reports, and dashboards.
* Support implementation of pilot initiatives
* Business Development Support
* Help prepare proposals, case studies, and pitch materials for new hospital clients.


 Compensation Structure (Activity \+ Performance Based)
 
 This is a
 
 variable\-pay internship
 
 . Earnings are tied to completed tasks, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
 


* Base Task Stipend
 
 : Fixed amount per approved deliverable (e.g., research report, analysis deck, client interview summary).
* Performance Incentives
 
 :
* Bonus for on\-time, high\-quality delivery.
* Additional incentive for client\-impacting outcomes (e.g., leads converted, pilots launched, measurable efficiency gains).



*Note: Exact payout slabs and KPIs will be shared during onboarding and may vary by project.* 




  




 Duration \& Work Mode
 * Duration
 
 : 8–12 weeks (extendable based on performance and project needs).
* Work Mode
 
 : Fully remote. You’ll collaborate via video calls, shared docs, and project management tools. Occasional virtual meetings with hospital clients during Indian business hours.


 What You’ll Gain
 * Real consulting experience with live hospital clients.
* Exposure to healthcare operations, strategy, and digital transformation.
* Mentorship from experienced consultants and healthcare operators.
* Certificate of completion and letter of recommendation for top performers.
* Potential pathway to a full\-time role or paid project engagement.
